name: Nantong Jiangshan Agrochemical & Chemicals Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nantong Jiangshan Agrochemical & Chemicals Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pesticide products in China and internationally. The company offers herbicides, including glyphosate, alachlor, acetochlor, butachlor, butachlor+propanil, quizalofop-p-ethyl, and metolachlor; insecticides, such as dichlorvos, trichlorphon, diazinon, nitenpyram, and imidaclothiz; and fungicides comprising prochloraz and prochloraz manganese complex.
